blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang reminded the camp of former president Rodrigo Duterte that a law allows the Philippine government to extradite individuals accused of crimes against humanity to international tribunals if the international body has begun prosecuting such crimes. During a press briefing in Baguio City on Thursday, Palace press officer and Undersecretary Claire Castro was asked to comment on the statements made by Duterte’s daughter, Vice President Sara Duterte, regarding the Supreme Court (SC) decision to dismiss the petitions for writs of habeas corpus.
